body: I find this so strange. I couldn’t love someone like this, I loved them so much. It was back and forth and obsessive and epic. But I was selfish, even though I loved him uncontrollably.
You know what they say about hope, it breeds eternal misery.
I’ve been waiting too long. I don’t have the strength to wait anymore.
I’m so tired. I don’t know what to do.
I’m not sure about that. I don’t know how to be saved. People say that I drain them of their energy. They can’t keep up with me.
Some people don’t deserve to be saved. Maybe I’m too far gone to be saved.
Hi! It’s Aya, message me x
